newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs end slightly higher on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: JGBs end slightly higher on short-covering.

text.p: *Key June JGB futures ended slightly higher on short-covering. *Trade was sluggish, as market players took a wait-and-see stance ahead of a 10-year JGB auction scheduled on Tuesday. *A speech by the BOJ governor to open the BOJ's branch managers meeting had little impact on JGBs, traders said.
